b_ref_imputation.definition: For names absent from B_ref (~20% of book at 2026-05-01), imputed B_i,k = sign(median(B_ref[,k])) * median(|B_ref[,k]|). This forces absent names to bear at least median magnitude hedge cost in QP, preventing the QP from exploiting B_i=0 as a free-rider corner solution.
